subject: A conforming implementation
notes: kb/Work PB1525 landed (wave 1020 A). The four sentences of the paragraph: (a) class 3 - the selectable nonstandard behaviours have a standard default and an implementor-defined selector (--permissive, --sign-encoding ibm|ascii, --source-format fixed|free|auto; src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Cli/Program.cs); (b)+(c-reserved words) the 15 extension-reserved words are specified in docs/CONFORMANCE.md D-RW1, equal to cobol-words.json extensionReserved (CobolWordsDriftTests) and to the ReservedWords of the register's rows (NonstandardExtensionRegisterDriftTests); (c-extensions) docs/CONFORMANCE.md 3.2 identifies the nonstandard extensions for which support is claimed, one table row per register row; (d) the warning mechanism is `cobol --flag-extensions`: optional (off by default, byte-identical output without it), at compile time, COBOL2894 at each use of a syntactically distinguishable extension, and ONLY those - a standard spelling (COMP, COMPUTATIONAL, BINARY, PACKED-DECIMAL, DISPLAY) is never named (AStandardUsageSpelling_IsNeverNamed) and --source-format auto, which is a property of the invocation, is documented and not flagged. The >>FLAG-02/-14 pass (FlagConformancePass) flags ISO migration items, a different §4.2.12/§4.2.13 mechanism, and is unchanged. GR-4.2.10-2 (the class-2 members) is CONFORMS: kb/Work PB298 re-probed both members the earlier PARTIAL named (the OPTIONS FLOAT-DECIMAL clause, COBOL2424; the EC-MCS-* names, COBOL1578) and closed it.
